title: Devin AI: is the first AI software engineer worth the hype?

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Devin AI is the first true software engineer — it writes clean, scalable code with minimal human intervention. (3 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: But Devin lacks real-world context — it can't debug legacy systems or understand nuanced business logic. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: It integrates with GitHub and uses advanced code synthesis — faster than any human in repetitive tasks. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Its outputs are brittle — without proper training, it generates code that breaks under edge cases. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: AI: is the future — adaptive, learning from every interaction, not just pre-set templates. (4 sec)
